package.description: Results software for the MESI ABPI MD ankle-brachial index measuring device

en-US.description: Results software for the MESI ABPI MD ankle-brachial index measuring device
en-US.longDescription: MESIresults is the companion application for the MESI ABPI MD device for measuring the ankle-brachial index. Connecting the device over the supplied USB cable imports patient data and enables printed and electronic handouts of results, with institution details such as name, address, and logo saved once and printed on every file leaving your healthcare facility.
en-US.name: MESIresults

zh-CN.description: MESI ABPI MD 踝臂指数测量设备的结果软件
zh-CN.longDescription: MESIresults 是 MESI ABPI MD 踝臂指数测量设备的配套应用。通过随附的 USB 线连接设备后，可导入患者数据，并以打印或电子形式输出结果报告；机构名称、地址和徽标等信息均可保存，并打印在离开医疗机构的每一份文件上。
